set.name: Coolness
set.theme: Ways to stay cool in the summer heat. Remake of the existing set for an A/B comparison with the original cards 41-50.
set.producer_notes: Benchmark set: reproduce the original objects as closely as possible so the result can be compared side by side with data/cards/041-050.

cards.name: Fan
cards.object: A light-blue pedestal fan with a round silver wire cage, three wide sky-blue blades and a chrome pole, seen from the front and slightly above.
cards.environment_details: an orange wall, a window with sky on the left, a long green curtain moving in the breeze

cards.name: Vending
cards.object: A chunky bright-blue vending machine with a glass front showing rows of colorful cans and bottles, a small screen and a silver pickup tray.

cards.name: Ice Cubes
cards.object: A hot-pink silicone ice cube tray with four cells, three translucent frosty ice cubes inside and one cube popped out on top, frost crystals on the edges.

cards.name: Aircon
cards.object: A white wall-mounted air conditioner unit with a small house icon on the front, rounded edges, blowing visible pale-blue streams of cold air downwards.
cards.surface: wall (unit mounted on the wall, room corner visible)

cards.name: Mojito
cards.object: A tall glass of pale-green mojito with big ice cubes, lime wedges, mint leaves on top and an orange bendy straw, condensation drops on the glass.

cards.name: Fresh Air
cards.object: A white open double window built into a wall, both shutters swung outward, a bright lime-green curtain billowing out of the dark-blue interior.
cards.surface: orange brick wall (window set into the wall)

cards.name: Ice Pop
cards.object: A raspberry-red popsicle on a wooden stick, two grooves along its body, frosty crystals and melting drops, tilted diagonally.

cards.name: Fruit Plate
cards.object: A round glass plate with a big watermelon slice, two orange wedges, a bunch of green grapes, strawberries and blueberries, water droplets on the fruit, seen from above at an angle.

cards.name: Pool
cards.object: A round inflatable kiddie pool with three rings in pink, yellow and blue, filled with water, a small yellow rubber duck floating in the middle.
cards.environment_details: bright green grass, a wooden fence behind

cards.name: Fan Fold
cards.object: An open purple folding hand fan with light wooden ribs, pleated paper, held open in a half circle, tilted.
